anomalies.description: A large crowd of people, including individuals in police uniforms and others holding banners with Arabic script, are engaged in chaotic physical confrontations, pushing, shoving, and grappling across multiple frames. Police officers are actively intervening, using batons and physical restraint amid dense crowd movement, indicating collective violent unrest.

Multiple instances of mutual physical combat are visible: individuals in civilian clothing and police officers are seen grabbing, striking, and wrestling each other (e.g., officer in light blue shirt restraining a man at f4–f6; men in black and white shirts grappling at f8–f10; man in suit being pushed at f11). These are direct interpersonal violent engagements.

A large, agitated crowd surrounds multiple police officers engaged in physical confrontations; individuals are seen pushing, grabbing, and intervening, with black-and-white flags (including what appear to be ISIS-style banners) visible, indicating collective violent unrest beyond isolated scuffles.

Two police officers physically restrain and grapple with a person wearing dark clothing and a head covering in the center of a dense crowd; the struggle involves pushing, pulling, and close-contact control maneuvers.

During the restraint, one officer appears to press the face or head of the restrained individual downward forcefully while the person is in a vulnerable position, suggesting potential excessive force against a non-resisting or subdued subject.

A large, agitated crowd with banners (including black-and-white flags associated with extremist groups) clashes violently with police; the scene shows collective unrest, coordinated aggression, and loss of public order beyond isolated scuffles.

Multiple individuals, including police officers in high-visibility vests and civilians, are engaged in mutual physical combat: pushing, grabbing, and striking in a dense crowd. The interaction is reciprocal and dynamic across frames.

A police dog is actively biting and holding down a person lying on the ground while multiple officers surround and restrain the individual; the person appears helpless and unable to resist, indicating abuse rather than mutual combat.
A police dog is actively biting and holding down a person lying on the ground while multiple officers surround and restrain the individual; the person appears helpless and unable to resist.
A police dog is actively biting and holding down a person lying on the ground while an officer restrains the dog or the person; the person appears helpless and unable to resist.

After the dog is removed, officers continue to physically restrain the individual on the ground; one officer appears to be striking or applying force to the person’s head/upper body while others hold limbs, suggesting active physical struggle or resistance.

Multiple officers surround and physically handle a prone, injured individual (visible head wound) on the grass and curb; the person remains motionless and unresisting while being lifted and moved, indicating helplessness.; Two uniformed officers are restraining a man lying on the ground with visible head injury and blood; the man appears helpless and is being manipulated (lifted, rolled, pinned) without resistance, consistent with abuse of a subdued individual.
Initial struggle where the man is on his back/side while officers apply force; possible mutual physical engagement before full subdual, though the man’s capacity to resist is unclear due to injury.
